name: Study Companion
tagline: AI-Driven Educational Assistant for quiz generation, Leitner flashcards, and TTS audio tutoring.
description:
Empower your learning with AI. Convert physical textbooks, lecture notes, and handwritten materials into interactive digital study sets, practice quizzes, Leitner flashcards, and audio tutoring sessions.

Intelligent Learning

🔍 Precision OCR

Extract text from photos of textbooks or handwritten notes with high accuracy using Google ML Kit. Digitizing notes has never been easier.

🤖 AI Question Gen

Instantly generate practice quizzes (MCQs, Essay, Short Answer) directly from your scanned materials to test your knowledge.

📝 Auto-Flashcards

Convert your notes into Leitner-style flashcards for active recall and spaced repetition study, optimized for long-term retention.

🎧 AI Tutor Mode

Built-in Text-to-Speech (TTS) allows you to listen to your study material or notes while on the move. Listen and learn anywhere.

🚀 Student User Guide

Step 1: Scan Your Material

Open app and tap Scan. Take photos of textbook pages or handwritten notes. The app extracts text in real time.

Step 2: Generate Study Sets

Tap Confirm & Generate. AI will process your text and create personalized tests, notes, and flashcards.

Step 3: Practice & Master

Take a timed MCQ test to verify knowledge, or use the flashcard deck for active recall. Use Tutor mode to listen on the go.

Step 4: Track Progress

Check the Analytics screen to see study streaks, XP, and badges. Use Revision Mode to focus on missed questions.
